meta.title: 面部设计 五官分析 颜值
meta.title_en: Facial Design: What Actually Makes a Face Attractive

scenes.context: 开场先把「双眼皮=好看」这条常见标准拆掉，否定最容易误导人的归因。
scenes.speak: First dismantle the common standard. Double eyelids don't equal pretty.

scenes.context: 对应肯定：黄字标出「眼眶骨」，把重点放到眶缘体积上。
sentences: Shift focus to the rim's volume.
Yellow text marks the key word.
paraphrase: Shift focus to the rim's volume.
Yellow text marks the key word.
scenes.speak: Shift focus to the rim's volume. Yellow text marks the key word.

scenes.context: 侧脸否定：鼻梁高度不是本片认定的核心。
scenes.speak: Nose-bridge height isn't the core. Reject another common attribution.

scenes.context: 侧脸肯定：黄字「上颌骨」，指向中面部饱满度。
sentences: The maxilla points to the mid-face.
paraphrase: The maxilla points to the mid-face.
scenes.speak: The maxilla points to the mid-face. Fullness decides the dimensionality.

scenes.context: 唇部否定：不把「嘟嘟唇」当成独立答案。
sentences: Pouty lips alone aren't the answer.
paraphrase: Pouty lips alone aren't the answer.
scenes.speak: Pouty lips alone aren't the answer. Reject the local-only mindset.

scenes.context: 唇部肯定：黄字「口周」，强调口周区域的整体饱满。
sentences: Perioral fullness is what reads as pretty.
Go from the part back to the whole.
paraphrase: Perioral fullness is what reads as pretty.
Go from the part back to the whole.
scenes.speak: Perioral fullness is what reads as pretty. Go from the part back to the whole.

scenes.context: 脸型否定：窄脸不是本片的终点标准。
sentences: A narrow face isn't the end standard.
paraphrase: A narrow face isn't the end standard.
scenes.speak: A narrow face isn't the end standard. Don't chase a single metric.

scenes.context: 收束肯定：前脸/后脸转折清楚，立体感被推到前台。
sentences: Dimensionality is pushed to the fore.
paraphrase: Dimensionality is pushed to the fore.
scenes.speak: A clean front-to-side face turn. Dimensionality is pushed to the fore.

practice: 双眼皮不是好看的关键，怎么说？
Double eyelids aren't what makes you pretty.
Put the focus on the orbital rim.
Overall fullness around the mouth reads as pretty.
pitfalls: 以为好看=单一生理特征
看眶缘、上颌骨等整体结构
美是整体结构而非单一五官
眼眶骨决定上半脸立体度
上颌骨饱满比鼻梁更关键
局部细节不如整体协调重要
shifts: 以为好看=单一生理特征
